desc: Read input N, arrays A, B, C.
Identify the set D of indices where A[i] != B[i].
Split D into P (where A[i]==1) and Z (where A[i]==0).
Sort P by C[i] descending, and Z by C[i] ascending.
Create the final operation order by concatenating P and Z.
Simulate the process: calculate initial sum of C[k] for all k where A[k]==1. Iterate through the order, adding the current sum to total cost and updating the current sum based on the flip.
